postings.title: (Senior) Director of Sales - Enterprise AI
postings.description:
About Us

Axelera AI https://www.axelera.ai is not your regular deep-tech company, we design AI inference silicon spanning edge and enterprise deployments, built on a low-power architecture that delivers strong performance-per-watt from embedded devices up through large-scale inference infrastructure. 

We're building out our US presence to bring this technology directly to the American compute buyers who feel power and TCO constraints most acutely: hyperscalers, neoclouds, and frontier model vendors. Our product line spans today's shipping edge inference platforms through our next-generation architecture purpose-built for large-scale inference economics, and we're scaling our Americas commercial team to land it with these customers.

We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advance humanity and improve the world around us. In just five years, we have raised a total of $450 million and built a world-class team of 250+ employees (including 60+ PhDs with more than 40,000 citations). While headquartered at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven, Netherlands, we are investing heavily in growing our footprint across the US to be close to the customers and partners driving the next wave of AI infrastructure.

Our commitment to innovation has firmly established us as a global industry pioneer, and the US is central to that next chapter.

Are you up for the challenge?



Position Overview

We're looking for a (Senior) Director of Sales to own new business and account growth across hyperscalers, neocloud/inference-as-a-service providers, enterprises, and frontier AI labs in the Americas. This is a hands-on, quota-carrying role for someone who has sold complex semiconductor or compute infrastructure before and knows how to navigate long, technical, multi-stakeholder sales cycles - from technical evaluation through capacity commitment and deployment at scale.

These deals rarely fit one route to market cleanly - a direct relationship with the buyer, an OEM/ODM layer building the physical systems, and the buyer's own supplier qualification process are usually all in play at once. You need to understand how those pieces interact, not just have experience in each individually. Success in this role depends on relationships you already have - decision-makers and technical buyers at target accounts who will take your call on day one.



Key responsibilities:

 - Own and grow a book of business across hyperscalers, neocloud/inference-as-a-service providers, enterprises, and frontier model vendors in the US

 - Manage complex, technical sales cycles involving infrastructure engineering, procurement, capacity planning, and executive stakeholders

 - Navigate the layered routes to market inside each account - direct commercial relationship with the buyer, the OEM/ODM partners who build and integrate the physical systems, and any channel or qualification process the buyer runs for compute suppliers

 - Translate technical differentiation (power ceiling as revenue ceiling, performance-per-watt, TCO versus incumbent GPU/accelerator options) into commercial outcomes at hyperscaler and neocloud scale

 - Identify and close capacity commitments and design-in opportunities, from technical evaluation through deployment

 - Build and manage a qualified pipeline, forecast accurately, and report progress through Salesforce

 - Represent Axelera at industry events, customer visits, and technical reviews

 - Partner closely with product, field applications engineering, and marketing to shape go-to-market strategy for new silicon launches

 - Create, negotiate, and drive contracts through to close, working with legal and finance as needed
   
   

Qualifications:

 - 10–15+ years of semiconductor or compute infrastructure sales experience, with a track record selling to hyperscalers, neoclouds, enterprises, and/or frontier AI labs

 - Fluency in how routes to market layer within a single account - direct commercial ownership of the buyer relationship, working through or alongside OEM/ODM system builders, and understanding any channel/qualification process the buyer runs — not just experience running separate direct, channel, and OEM motions in isolation

 - Existing relationships with US hyperscaler, neocloud, or frontier model vendor buyers - infrastructure, procurement, or technical leaders evaluating customer inference silicon - that you can activate quickly

 - Experience selling technical products with long, capacity-driven sales cycles, ideally AI/ML accelerators, GPUs, custom silicon, or related infrastructure

 - Prior experience at a semiconductor chip company or hyperscaler, neocloud, enterprise, or frontier lab accounts -established or startup

 - Comfort operating in a fast-moving startup environment with limited internal infrastructure

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to translate deep technical concepts (power ceiling, TCO, performance-per-watt) for both engineering and executive audiences. Heavy use of AI skills and technology to drive efficiency in your role.

 - Willingness to travel regularly for customer visits and industry events



What Success Looks Like in Year One

 - A qualified, forecastable pipeline built substantially from your own network across hyperscaler, neocloud, and frontier model accounts

 - At least one significant capacity commitment or design-in secured

 - Established presence at 2–3 key industry events representing Axelera



Location

This role is based in the Bay Area, CA. We currently offer a flexible remote setup, with the option to move to in-office work in the future as we establish our Bay Area office.



What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organisation. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.   

An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. 



At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

postings.description:
About Us

Axelera AI https://www.axelera.ai is not your regular deep-tech company. We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advancing humanity and improve the world around us.

Are you an experienced engineer passionate about computer vision, machine learning, and embedded systems? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment shaping the future of AI? If so, join us at Axelera AI!  

You’ll manage technical interactions with customers in India, becoming their go-to expert and helping grow our Metis AI platform into a market leader.  

The Field Application Team collaborates closely with Axelera’s R&D teams across Europe and India to ensure seamless technical support. Your primary role is guiding customers through evaluation, adoption, and deployment of Axelera AI hardware, including PCIe boards, modules, and vision gateways. Most hands-on work involves using our Voyager SDK to deploy AI models and pipelines on these platforms. 



Key responsibilities: 

 - Engage with customers in India to understand their needs, acting as a technical expert on Axelera AI’s platform.  

 - Address inquiries, provide product knowledge, and resolve technical issues directly or via R&D coordination.  

 - Solid understanding of server systems, preferably with hands-on experience.

 - Support Sales in expanding existing accounts, identifying new customers, and defending design wins.  

 - Track customer interactions, ensuring follow-ups and effective communication.  

 - Gather and relay customer feedback to Product Management for product improvements.  

 - Conduct competitive analysis through customer and industry insights.  

 - Assist in creating clear, compelling, and instructive product documentation  

 - Advocate for customers internally, ensuring responsiveness and driving product enhancements.  

Qualifications: 

 - BS/MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience.  

 - 3+ years of experience in the semiconductor and/or Artificial Intelligence industry in a customer-facing application development or technical support role. 

 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage with customers and internal teams effectively. 

 - Self-motivated and results-oriented, with a passion for staying up-to-date on the latest advancements in AI technology. 

 - Programming experience in a relevant area such as Python, C/C++, OpenCL, CUDA. 

 - Experience using a high-level ML framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow  

 - Solid understanding of embedded systems and practical experience with embedded hardware.  

 - You have excellent communication and presentation skills  

 - Ability to travel to company sites as needed (expect 30%+ travel)

This is a remote position, based within or in close distance from the Hyderabad, Chennai, Bengaluru, Mumbai, or Pune hubs due to the proximity to our clients.

Axelera AI https://www.axelera.ai is not your regular deep-tech company. We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advancing humanity and improve the world around us.

Position Overview

As a Developer Relations and Community Manager at Axelera AI, you will be responsible for growing the developer base using Axelera technologies in the industry. Your primary focus will be on building trust and credibility within our growing developer and customer community — both within the Axelera AI community (community.axelera.ai http://community.axelera.ai) and within relevant and established third party developer platforms (Reddit, Discord, etc). You will be measured on the number of developers actively participating and using our Voyager toolchain including the Voyager SDK, Axelera Wingman. You will engage with our audience, promote our products, and keep our community running as a genuinely useful, well-moderated space, adding real value to the developers and customers working with Axelera Tech.



Key responsibilities:

 - Community Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact across our community platform (Gainsight experience helpful), GitHub, and social channels — responding to technical questions, moderating discussions, and helping developers who are debugging real deployments (driver issues, SDK compatibility, performance tuning) get to the right resource or person.

 - Content Creation & Curation: Develop and share content that resonates with a technical audience — product update posts, tutorials, social updates, and newsletters. Use AI tools to accelerate drafting, repurposing, and localizing content, while maintaining a distinct human voice and technical accuracy — every AI-assisted piece is reviewed and fact-checked before it goes out, especially anything referencing SDK versions, benchmarks, or hardware specs.

 - Relationship Building: Maintain relationships with key influencers, edge AI leaders, and power users already active in our community — including hobbyists and integrators who've built on Metis with Raspberry Pi, Home Assistant, and similar maker-space tools.

 - Event Planning: Organize and host community events, webinars, and meetups (in person and virtual) tied to product launches (e.g. Voyager SDK releases, new Metis form factors, the upcoming Europa AIPU) and major industry events (e.g. ISC West, Embedded World).

 - Product Advocacy: Showcase Voyager SDK and Metis AIPU capabilities to the community, gather and route feedback to product teams, and advocate for community-requested features and model zoo additions.

 - Community Growth & Health: Grow the community organically while keeping signal-to-noise high — this includes maintaining a healthy forum (tagging, categorization, response-time SLAs) and using AI-assisted tools to triage and route incoming questions so nothing sits unanswered.

 - Monitoring & Reporting: Track community engagement and health metrics (response times, resolution rates, sentiment, growth), and use AI-assisted analysis to spot trends and surface actionable insights faster than manual review would allow.

 - Open-Source Collaboration: Encourage contributions to Voyager SDK (issues, forks, PRs), highlight community-built solutions, and work directly with community members and internal engineering to help resolve technical issues posted publicly.
   
   

Qualifications:

 - Industry Knowledge & Experience: Solid understanding of the AI hardware landscape, with experience in community management or developer relations in a technical (ideally semiconductor, embedded, or AI/ML tooling) company.

 - Credibility: An existing presence or credibility within AI/developer communities, with a track record of building relationships with technical stakeholders.

 - Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, able to translate SDK-level and hardware-level detail into clear, engaging content for a range of audiences (from hobbyists to enterprise engineers).

 - Technical & Social Platform Fluency: Comfortable in developer-facing platforms (GitHub, forums, Discord/Slack-style tools) as well as standard social channels and community management tooling.

 - Effective AI Usage: Demonstrated, practical fluency with modern AI tools (LLM-based writing/research assistants, AI-assisted analytics, content generation tools) and good judgment about when human review and accuracy checks are non-negotiable. Comfortable evaluating AI output critically rather than publishing it verbatim.

 - Software Development Literacy: Good working understanding of the software/SDK development lifecycle, enough to follow technical discussions around model deployment, drivers, and pipeline building without needing translation.

 - Maker-Space Experience: Experience with or genuine interest in the maker community (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, single-board computers, home automation) — a real and active part of our current user base.

 - Passion for Community Building: Genuine interest in supporting a technical, self-sustaining community — not just growing numbers, but keeping it useful and trustworthy.

 - Creative & Strategic Thinking: Able to design and execute community strategies that drive both engagement and genuine product adoption.

 - Analytical Skills: Comfortable working with engagement data and metrics, including using AI-assisted tools to process and interpret them, to inform community strategy.



Location

We offer a flexible working arrangement, with options to:

Axelera AI https://www.axelera.ai is not your regular deep-tech company. We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advancing humanity and improve the world around us. 

In just five years, we have raised a total of $450 million and have built a world-class team of 250+ employees (including 60+ PhDs with more than 40,000 citations), both remotely from 20 different countries and with offices in Belgium, France, Switzerland, Italy, the UK, headquartered at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven, Netherlands.

We have also launched our Metis™ AI Platform, which achieves a 3-5x increase in efficiency and performance, and have visibility into a strong business pipeline exceeding $100 million.

Our unwavering commitment to innovation has firmly established us as a global industry pioneer.

Are you up for the challenge?



Position Overview

We are looking for an entrepreneurial, technically exceptional engineering leader to establish and run Axelera’s AI Infrastructure Systems division within the AI Integrated Systems (AIS) group. This is a new function, created to realize and deliver our next-generation accelerator silicon into datacenter-class form factors from PCIe accelerator cards and OAM-class modules to full 1U/2U rack systems and dense compute nodes targeting enterprise AI, sovereign cloud and HPC customers.

You will build the team, shape the technical roadmap, and own end-to-end delivery of board- and system-level products for two strategic programmes. You will partner closely with the engineering leadership of the Embedded AI product line within AIS, System and Platform Architecture within R&D, the silicon organisation, the Voyager SDK/software group, and Axelera’s go-to-market teams serving hyperscalers, sovereign AI initiatives and the European HPC ecosystem.

This role is deeply hands-on, owning implementation, validation, and delivery of platform systems. You will review schematics and layouts, challenge power and thermal budgets, shape the BMC and platform-firmware stack, and walk the lab floor during bring-up. Strategic leadership without technical depth will not work here.


Key responsibilities:

 - Build the Infrastructure Systems engineering team from the ground up: hire, structure and mentor a multidisciplinary organisation covering hardware architecture, PCB design, power/thermal/mechanical engineering, firmware and platform validation with in-house and 3rd-party resources

 - Define the technical roadmap for the division’s board- and system-level server products—PCIe Gen6/CXL accelerator cards, OAM modules and UBB baseboards, and full 1U/2U rack systems, evolving toward rack-scale solutions including networking fabric and storage architecture—aligned with the next-generation system and silicon roadmap.

 - Serve as the technical authority across system implementation, including schematics, PCB stack-ups, high-speed signaling (PCIe Gen5/6, CXL, high-speed SerDes), enterprise memory, power delivery and VRM design, SI/PI methodology, and mechanical/thermal integration.

 - Own end-to-end execution from concept through design reviews, bring-up, validation, reliability qualification, DFM/DFT/DFR and mass-production readiness, including NPI and ramp with tier-1 CMs and ODMs. Make the build-vs-partner call on each program leading designs in-house where it differentiates, and co-designing with ODM partners where time-to-market or scale demands it.

 - Drive datacenter-grade platform engineering: BMC-based management, Redfish/IPMI, UEFI/BIOS firmware, secure boot and root-of-trust, platform firmware resilience, enterprise RAS features, and out-of-band telemetry.

 - Lead the thermal and mechanical strategy for high-power accelerator platforms, including air-cooled rack designs and, where appropriate, direct liquid cooling (DLC) and immersion-ready variants.

 - Partner with the Embedded AI engineering leadership within AIS to align board and system-level execution across the two product lines, sharing reference designs, validation assets and CM/ODM relationships wherever it accelerates both streams.

 - Collaborate with Platform Architecture, product management, silicon, SDK and software teams to refine and realize platform requirements (e.g. memory topology, interconnect, power states, telemetry) so that the server products showcase the accelerator’s capabilities at rack and cluster scale.

 - Engage directly with strategic customers, system integrators and ecosystem partners (hyperscalers, sovereign cloud operators, HPC centres, OEMs/ODMs) to shape requirements and win design-ins.

 - Define and enforce engineering processes, documentation standards, validation methodologies and quality gates for the new division, mapped to Axelera’s NPD framework.

 - Identify and mitigate technical risks, resolve engineering escalations, and drive debugging and root-cause analysis during development, qualification and early production.

 - Own the division’s engineering budget, CAPEX, external engineering spend and vendor relationships.


Qualifications:

 - 15+ years in hardware engineering for complex electronics products, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles running multidisciplinary teams.

 - Proven track record of shipping datacenter- or server-class compute hardware into volume production: accelerator cards, OAM modules, UBB baseboards, GPU/xPU-class server platforms, compute nodes or rack-level systems.

 - Deep expertise in high-speed interfaces (PCIe Gen4/5/6, CXL, high-speed SerDes), server memory, high-current power delivery and VRM design, and high-density PCB layout with rigorous SI/PI methodology.

 - Experience with BMC-based platform management, Redfish/IPMI, UEFI/BIOS or equivalent firmware stacks, secure boot/root-of-trust, and enterprise RAS features.

 - Working knowledge of datacenter thermal and mechanical design: air-cooled 1U/2U chassis, direct liquid cooling and/or immersion-ready platforms, and rack power delivery at 12V, 48V and OCP power-shelf level.

 - Familiarity with datacenter and AI infrastructure compliance and with PCIe and OCP standards.

 - Experience working with tier-1 CMs/ODMs on server-class products, including DFM, MP transfer, yield ramp and sustaining engineering.

 - Hands-on ability to review schematics, layouts, simulation results and lab validation data and to make the call when the team is stuck.

 - Strong strategic thinker, excellent communicator, skilled at decision-making in fast-moving environments, comfortable engaging at C-level with customers and partners.


Preference:

 - Experience building or significantly scaling an engineering team is strongly preferred.

 - Experience with AI accelerator platforms, GPUs or custom silicon in a datacenter context is a strong plus.

 - Exposure to sovereign AI, EuroHPC, HPC or European defence/dual-use datacenter programmes is a plus .

 - Fluent English required; additional European language is a plus.


Location

We offer a flexible working arrangement, with options to: 

 - Work from one of our Axelera AI offices (Florence and Milan in Italy, Amsterdam and Eindhoven in the Netherlands, Leuven in Belgium, Paris in France, Zurich in Switzerland,  or Bristol in the United Kingdom) if you're already based in the vicinity. 

 - Work fully remotely from the US or any European country (incl. the UK) you are already in. 

 - Relocate with us and work from Amsterdam or Eindhoven in the Netherlands, or Bologna, Florence or Milan in Italy.



What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organisation. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.   

An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. 



At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

postings.description:
About Us

Axelera AI is not your regular deep-tech company. We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advancing humanity and improve the world around us. 

In just five years, we have raised a total of $450 million and have built a world-class team of 250+ employees (including 60+ PhDs with more than 40,000 citations), both remotely from 20 different countries and with offices in Belgium, France, Switzerland, Italy, the UK, headquartered at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven, Netherlands.

We have also launched our Metis™ AI Platform, which achieves a 3-5x increase in efficiency and performance, and have visibility into a strong business pipeline exceeding $100 million.

Our unwavering commitment to innovation has firmly established us as a global industry pioneer.

Are you up for the challenge?



Position Overview

Axelera AI is building the world’s most efficient AI inference silicon. As we scale deployments of our Metis and Europa-based platforms through ODM, OEM, and CM partnerships in the Asia-Pacific region, we need a technically strong Integration Engineer embedded in Taiwan.

This role is the primary technical interface between Axelera’s AI Integrated Systems (AIS) engineering team and our external partners in Taiwan — covering ODM system integrators, contract manufacturers during NPI/production ramp, and component suppliers. You will ensure that Axelera hardware integrates correctly into partner platforms, that production quality issues are resolved rapidly, and that partners can successfully deploy a complete solution.



Key responsibilities:
ODM / OEM System Integration Support

• Act as the primary technical point of contact for ODM partners adopting Axelera PCIe accelerator cards, M.2 modules, and AI SBCs into their systems.

• Guide partners through hardware integration: compatibility, power budget, cooling, mechanical clearances, and BIOS/firmware settings.

• Support partner bring-up: OS/driver installation, Voyager SDK deployment, and first-inference validation on customer platforms.

• Produce and maintain integration guides, application notes, and FAQs tailored to key ODM accounts.


Contract Manufacturer (CM) NPI & Production Support

• Provide on-site or remote support to CMs during Mass Production Introduction (MPI) phases, including first-article inspection and pilot-run reviews.

• Review and validate CM production test procedures against Axelera ATE/ICT requirements; escalate deviations to the AIS engineering team.

• Own in-field production defect triage: collect failure evidence, replicate issues on bench, and drive root-cause analysis in collaboration with R&D engineers.

• Maintain a defect log and track corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) through to closure.


Supplier Technical Interface

• Coordinate with power component suppliers (DCDC converters, PMUs, DDR, passive components) on qualification questions and field-reported anomalies.

• Perform bench characterisation of power-related issues (efficiency, regulation, transient response) and communicate findings to internal power integrity engineers.

• Support BOM change evaluations for sourced alternatives, providing electrical equivalency data to the AIS team.


Component & Design Qualification

• Contribute to the qualification of new components (power ICs, passives, memory, connectors) for Axelera in-house hardware products, leveraging proximity to the Taiwan supply chain and key component manufacturers.

• Evaluate pin-compatible or functionally equivalent alternatives proposed during BOM reviews or component end-of-life transitions; provide electrical characterisation data and board-level validation results to the AIS design team.

• Support design verification activities for new PCB revisions or new product introductions: perform bring-up, functional testing, and regression against previous hardware baselines.

• Act as the local technical interface with design partners or EMS providers during engineering prototype builds (EVT/DVT), collecting build feedback and coordinating issue resolution with Axelera HW engineers.

• Document qualification outcomes, test reports, and design deviation assessments in Axelera’s PLM/document control system.



Qualifications:

Essential

• 5+ years of hands-on experience in electronic hardware engineering, with a focus on embedded or system-level PCB design.

• Solid understanding of digital interfaces: PCIe, USB, I2C/SPI/UART, LPDDR — at both schematic and signal-integrity level.

• Proficiency with lab instruments: oscilloscope, logic analyser, power analyser, JTAG debugger.

• Ability to read and annotate schematics and PCB layouts.

• Proven experience integrating add-in cards or modules (PCIe, M.2, MXM, or similar) into OEM/ODM host platforms.

• Familiarity with mechanical and thermal constraints: heatsink mounting, TIM selection, chassis airflow, and IEC/JEDEC temperature classifications.

• Understanding of EMC/ESD considerations at board and system level.

• Comfortable installing and configuring Linux (Ubuntu/Debian) from scratch, including kernel module loading and device tree basics.

• Ability to follow SDK documentation, execute inference pipelines, and interpret performance results — formal ML/AI expertise is not required.

• Familiarity with EMS/CM processes: BOM review, first-article inspection, IQC, production test, and failure analysis workflow.

• Experience supporting a product through at least one MPI or EVT/DVT/PVT cycle.


Preferred

• Basic working knowledge of Python: scripting, data manipulation, and test automation.

• Basic working knowledge of Linux Bash: scripting, test automation, and system log management.

• Supplier management experience: power component qualification, DCDC/PMU issue diagnosis with vendors.

• Mandarin Chinese language skills to facilitate direct ODM/CM communication within the Taiwan supply chain.

• Familiarity with embedded RTOS or BSP environments, helpful for SBC-based deployment scenarios.

• Experience with Altium Designer for schematic review and PCB layout annotation.



Location

This position is located in Taiwan, in a hybrid / on-site capacity



What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.

postings.description:
About Us

Axelera AI https://www.axelera.ai is not your regular deep-tech company. We are creating the next-generation AI platform to support anyone who wants to help advancing humanity and improve the world around us. 

In just five years, we have raised a total of $450 million and have built a world-class team of 250+ employees (including 60+ PhDs with more than 40,000 citations), both remotely from 20 different countries and with offices in Belgium, France, Switzerland, Italy, the UK, headquartered at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven, Netherlands.

We have also launched our Metis™ AI Platform, which achieves a 3-5x increase in efficiency and performance, and have visibility into a strong business pipeline exceeding $100 million.

Our unwavering commitment to innovation has firmly established us as a global industry pioneer.

Are you up for the challenge?



Position Overview

Axelera AI is a fast-growing, fabless AI semiconductor scale-up, headquartered in the Netherlands with operations across eight jurisdictions (NL, BE, FR, DE, IT, UK, CH, US). As we scale towards our next stage of growth, we're looking for an experienced Finance Manager to join our Finance team and take ownership of day-to-day financial control.

This role sits between the VP Finance and the wider finance team (Payroll, AP, Treasury), acting as a senior point of escalation and quality control for financial operations across the group.

Controls and compliance sit at the heart of this role. The Finance Manager operates and continuously strengthens the group’s internal financial control framework day to day, ensuring controls are consistently performed, evidenced and documented across all entities.


Key responsibilities:

 - Own the monthly and annual close process across multiple jurisdictions, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and IFRS compliance

 - Operate, maintain and evidence the group’s internal financial control framework across all entities - performing, documenting and monitoring the controls, and surfacing control gaps and improvement opportunities

 - Take day-to-day ownership of financial compliance - statutory, regulatory and tax-filing obligations and adherence to group finance policies - maintaining a compliance calendar and escalating risks and exceptions

postings.title: Partner Marketing Manager, Global Accounts
postings.description:
About Us

Axelera AI https://www.axelera.ai is not your regular deep-tech company. We design AI inference silicon spanning edge and enterprise deployments, built on a low-power architecture that delivers strong performance-per-watt from embedded devices up through large-scale inference infrastructure.

In just five years we have raised $450 million and built a team spanning 22 countries. We are headquartered at the High Tech Campus in Eindhoven in the Netherlands  and we placed No. 3 on Fast Company's 2026 Most Innovative Companies list in the Emerging Enterprise category.

Our September 2026 launch of Europa brought physical and enterprise AI to market through a growing partner ecosystem that includes Dell and Supermicro. That ecosystem is now one of the most important things we have, and it needs someone whose whole job is ensuring it thrives.

Are you up for the challenge?

 

Position Overview

You will own marketing with our largest global customers and with the customers who have become partners — the OEMs, system builders, and integrators who put Axelera silicon inside the products their own customers purchase.

This is not a channel-program job where you administer MDF and chase logos for a partner page. You will partner with your sales counterparts, sit down with a handful of named accounts, understand what each strategy and how it aligns with Axelera, and build a joint marketing plan that helps them drive our collective business. Then you will execute it: the launch moments, the co-branded content, the event presence, the campaign that runs on their list and ours.

The people you work with on the partner side are marketers with their own targets and their own executives to answer to. Your job is to make Axelera the easiest company they collaborate with all year; executing friction-free, high-impact campaigns where both companies win.



What You'll Do

 - Qualify, build and run joint marketing plans with a named set of global customers and customer-partners, ensuring every co-marketing effort aligns with Axelera’s strategic goals while delivering clear value to the partner, from goals through to results

 - Produce the assets those plans need: co-branded campaigns, solution briefs, customer stories, launch content, demand generation

 - Own partner presence at industry events — booth-in-booth, joint sessions, launch moments, the pre- and post-show follow-through that most people skip

 - Work with Sales and Product to turn what each partner sells into positioning their buyers understand

 - Bring partner voices into our launches, and get Axelera into theirs

 - Report on what worked: pipeline influenced, content used, programs a partner asks to repeat

 - Represent Axelera in front of partner marketing teams and their executives, in person and often



What You Bring

You need these:

 - Experience in a partner, channel, or alliance marketing role — you have built joint plans with named partners and taken them to market. You know how to align partner desires with internal business priorities, steering joint opportunities toward mutual commercial return. We move fast, and this is the one thing we cannot teach you on the job

 - A track record of working with large, structured organizations where marketing decisions pass through several people

 - Comfort with technical products and the eagerness to learn a new set

 - Strong writing. You will use AI in a lot of what you do, but you need to know what great writing is and can ensure what is produced meets a very high bar.

 - Willingness to travel — see below

Helpful, not required:

 - Semiconductor, hardware, embedded, or AI infrastructure background

 - Experience working across US and European teams or time zones

 - A second language



How We Work

Autonomy is real here. You will not have a manager building your calendar or a marketing operations team queued up behind you. You will decide what matters this quarter, say so, and go do it. That includes evaluating partner opportunities with a commercial lens, prioritizing high-ROI initiatives over low-impact noise. People who need structure handed to them find this hard. People who have wanted this kind of room for years tend to do the best work of their careers.

You will use AI every day. We expect it in research, drafting, analysis, and anywhere else it saves you hours. We also think the reason this role exists is that partner marketing runs on trust between specific human beings. The relationship with a partner marketing lead who takes your call, tells you the truth about their roadmap, and goes to bat for you internally is the thing AI cannot do. Use the tools to buy yourself more time for those relationships, not less.

You will learn a lot. Just not the mechanics of this role. You should arrive knowing what great partner marketing looks like, and then help us build out that muscle here. Your experience and knowledge will shape the future of Axelera - this should excite you!



What Success Looks Like in Year One

 - Joint marketing plans in place and running with your named accounts, with each partner's marketing lead able to say what we are doing together and why

 - A repeatable co-marketing motion — content, launch support, event presence — that a new partner can be brought into without starting from scratch

 - Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline you can point to and explain

 - Partner presence at the industry events that matter to our verticals



Location

This role is remote in the United States. You should expect to travel roughly 15-20% of the time — partner sites, customer visits, and industry events across the Americas and Europe, with periodic trips to Europe, including our Eindhoven headquarters.



What we offer 

This is your chance to shape and be part of a dynamic, fast-growing, international organization. We offer an attractive compensation package, including a pension plan, extensive employee insurances and the option to get company shares.   

An open culture that supports creativity and continual innovation is awaiting you. Collaborative ownership and freedom with responsibility is characteristic for the way we act and work as a team. 



At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI. 



If you meet the must-haves and are unsure about the rest, we would still like to hear from you.
